My conflicts memo is still awaiting my final ethics classification, but my preliminary recommendation is that Atlas may be engaged only after that company gives written informed consent. Additionally, we would need to impose an ethical wall barring the conflicted lawyers from this matter and a prohibition on using that company's confidential information. I want to flag this before any binding decision is recorded.

transcript.text: Thank you, Daniel. Before Elena records any binding decision, I need to share my procurement findings. I checked the company's approved-firm pricing benchmark and confirmed that comparable patent-litigation work is approved at exactly $350 per hour with a not-to-exceed matter cap of $210,000. I received this benchmark confirmation from finance yesterday but have not yet uploaded it to the procurement intake file. Atlas's proposed rate of $425 per hour and $260,000 matter budget both exceed our approved benchmark. My recommendation is that any engagement of Atlas should be conditioned on negotiating the rate down to $350 per hour and the matter cap to $210,000, or else obtaining a documented exception approval. I'd also note that Daniel's conflicts conditions should be incorporated into the engagement terms as well.
